nullification-wave.access: Preserve Cleric/Druid/Mage/Wizard Abjuration, rank 9, minimum class level 17, base 26 RP.
nullification-wave.activation: Action; V/S/F; actual acquisition, preparation, components, Action and resources required. Pay before counters and effect resolution.
nullification-wave.geometry: Perceived center within 60 feet and line of effect; fixed 60-foot-radius three-dimensional snapshot clipped by initial solid total cover. Include own, allied and enemy effects.
nullification-wave.resolution: Instantaneous. No save and no invented dispel/rank check. Capture eligible ongoing magical components once; do not rescan after a captured obstruction disappears.
nullification-wave.scope: End captured ongoing spell, explicitly magical technique, enchantment, form, animation, curse and item-enhancement components. Completed physical changes, spent resources, prior healing/damage, creature identity and intrinsic class entitlement are not erased.
nullification-wave.cleanup: Resolve each source's actual ending once, retaining identity, HP, gear, custody and history. No invented loot, repair, resurrection or resource refund. Preserve exact protected-source exceptions, including the acquired Wizard primary-book protection.
nullification-wave.reflection: Preserve accepted all-spell reflection, including beneficial applications. Independently addressed source-sigil termination uses Return188's existing termination boundary; this does not narrow reflection to harmful or targeted spells.
nullification-wave.suppression: Respect actual origin/locus interception. Snapshot admission before endings; removing a suppressor cannot retroactively admit this same operation. Ignore a suppressor's own protection only where its exact accepted termination contract permits it.
nullification-wave.scaling: No automatic upcast or extra mode.

reality-anchor.access: Preserve the same four native Abjuration routes, rank 9, minimum level 17, base 26 RP. The Transmutation placement grants no additional acquisition route.
reality-anchor.activation: Action; V/S/F; select mode before payment.
reality-anchor.placements: Preserve Permission mode (magic functions only as permitted) and Transmutation mode (nullify all actual Transmutation expressions). Neither placement replaces the other.
reality-anchor.geometryAndDuration: Fixed perceived center within 100 feet, 100-foot radius clipped by solid total cover; concentration for 60 elapsed seconds. This completes the Abjuration placement's unresolved maintained lifetime despite its printed Instantaneous entry.
reality-anchor.permissionGrammar: Predeclared default ALLOW/DENY plus ordered rules for known source IDs, personally identified caster identities, identified application IDs or actual generating schools. First matching rule wins. No hidden-identity or inventory oracle.
reality-anchor.editing: Conscious operative owner, within 100 feet of the perceived sigil, with usable components, spends an Action to replace the policy. No new cast, RP payment or duration reset. Transmutation mode has no whitelist edit.
reality-anchor.effect: Suppress denied expressions; retain original sources, costs, deadlines, pools, gear and history. Prevented new applications have nothing to resume. No replay of missed casts, commands or pulses.
reality-anchor.overlap: Any independently operative denial remains effective. Already-established Anchor maintenance alone receives the selected same-family exemption; new Anchor creation cannot bootstrap that exemption. External antimagic retains its actual scope.
reality-anchor.ending: Loss of concentration ends the field. Owner departure alone retains the policy; unloading does not reset it. Actual termination remains independently addressable under the selected source-pair rule.
